question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A person who falsely claims an identity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Impostor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pretender"** means someone who claims or aspires to a title or position without justification, often with deceit. (दिखावा करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **He was merely a pretender to the throne, with no real claim to it.
 
 
 
• **"Impostor"** refers to a person who pretends to be someone else in order to deceive others. (वेशधारी)
 
 
• **Example: **The man turned out to be an impostor, using a fake identity to scam people.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct one-word substitute for "A person who falsely claims an identity" is **"Impostor."**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Impostor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pretender** (दिखावा करने वाला): Someone who claims to be something they are not, often to achieve a goal.
 
 
• **Example:** The pretender claimed to be a wealthy businessman, but he was actually in debt.
 
 
 
• **Hypocrite** (पाखंडी): A person who professes beliefs or virtues they do not actually possess.
 
 
• **Example:** Calling someone out for lying while lying themselves makes them a hypocrite.
 
 
 
• **Actor** (अभिनेता): A person who performs in plays, movies, or television shows.
 
 
• **Example:** The actor delivered an outstanding performance in the film.

The correct answer is **option 1.**
